text: Rockfort Engineering Holdings Limited's active persons with significant control are Angus Rutherford Lyon and Oliver Rodney Thomas Jackson, each holding more than 25% but not more than 50% of the shares and voting rights.
short: Rockfort Engineering Holdings is controlled by Angus Lyon and Oliver Rodney Thomas Jackson.
